business_input.offer: Weekly and biweekly deep cleaning packages starting at £65, using non-toxic, eco-friendly products
business_input.brand_preferences: Professional but approachable, clean and minimal aesthetic, trustworthy

source_documents.text: FreshClean Pro was founded in 2023 by Sarah Mitchell, a former facilities manager who noticed that most cleaning companies in Manchester offered inconsistent quality and used harsh chemicals. Our team of 12 cleaners are all DBS-checked and trained in eco-cleaning methods. We serve residential properties in South Manchester and commercial offices in the city centre. Our most popular package is the weekly home refresh at £65 which includes kitchen deep clean, bathroom sanitisation, and living area vacuuming. We also offer one-off post-tenancy cleans. Clients book through our website or WhatsApp.

Services: Weekly Home Refresh (£65) - kitchen deep clean, bathroom sanitisation, living area vacuum and mop. Biweekly Deep Clean (£85) - full house deep clean including windows, skirting boards, and appliance exteriors. One-Off Post-Tenancy Clean (£150-250) - full property restoration clean. Commercial Office Clean - custom pricing based on square footage. All services use EcoVerde certified non-toxic cleaning products.

What our clients say: 'Finally a cleaning company that actually turns up on time and does a thorough job. Love that they use eco products too.' - Rachel T, Didsbury. 'We switched our office cleaning to FreshClean Pro six months ago. The difference is night and day.' - Mark S, Deansgate.
